description: The reverse of analyze_iban: give it a BIC/SWIFT code and it names the bank that holds the code - registered name, city, address and postcode, with the IBAN length and SEPA status of its country. Use it when a remittance file, an invoice or a supplier form carries a BIC and no IBAN; use analyze_iban when an IBAN is in hand, because that returns the BIC as well. A miss comes back as a stated reason - the code is malformed, its country is outside our coverage, or we hold no record - and never as a finding that the BIC is unregistered, which is not something this service is in a position to know. One BIC per call, by design. Requires an X-Api-Key header, and costs one bank lookup from the caller's monthly allowance only when a bank actually comes back.

bic.description: A BIC/SWIFT code, 8 or 11 characters, e.g. SPNODK22XXX. Spaces, hyphens and lower case are ignored. Both spellings of one code are accepted - SPNODK22 and SPNODK22XXX name the same office, and the answer says which form we hold it under. No country code is needed: characters 5 and 6 of a BIC are its country.

name: get_bank_by_bic
title: Find the bank holding a BIC
